title: CoSafe: Cooperative Runtime Safety Assurance for Mixed-Traffic Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.06204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rapid development of autonomous driving systems (ADSes), real-world roads are evolving into mixed-traffic environments where autonomous vehicles (AVs) and other traffic participants (e.g., human-driven vehicles (HDVs), cyclists, and pedestrians) coexist and interact with each other. However, current ADSes still incur various safety violations in mixed traffic scenarios, raising a strong demand for runtime safety assurance frameworks that can continuously monitor hazards and prevent potential violations. Existing ego-centric assurance approaches are insufficient for mixed traffic, where violations often arise from locally reasonable yet jointly incompatible decisions among multiple vehicles and cannot be reliably resolved through independent takeover. translated_title: CoSafe：面向混合交通自动驾驶的协同式运行时安全保障
translated_abstract: 随着自动驾驶系统（ADS）的快速发展，现实道路正在演变为混合交通环境，其中自动驾驶汽车（AV）与其他交通参与者（如人类驾驶车辆（HDV）、骑行者和行人）共存并相互作用。然而，当前的自动驾驶系统在混合交通场景中仍会出现各种安全违规行为，这引发了对能够持续监测危险并防止潜在违规的运行时安全保障框架的强烈需求。现有的以自我为中心的保障方法不足以应对混合交通场景，因为在这类场景中，违规行为往往源于多辆车之间局部合理但联合不兼容的决策，且无法通过独立接管来可靠解决。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了CoSafe，一个模块化且与自动驾驶系统无关的协同式运行时安全保障框架，用于混合交通自动驾驶，以将运行时安全扩展为……
tldr: 提出CoSafe——一个模块化、与自动驾驶系统无关的协同式运行时安全保障框架，通过多车协作解决混合交通中由局部合理但联合不兼容决策引发的安全违规问题。
en_tdlr: CoSafe is proposed as a modular, ADS-agnostic cooperative runtime safety assurance framework that resolves safety violations in mixed-traffic autonomous driving caused by locally reasonable yet jointly incompatible decisions among multiple vehicles.
